CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERCOUNTRYOFCITIZENSHIP_CRM] AS
BEGIN

--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship AS (
SELECT 
	BCD.ORGKEY AS CustomerId
	,NULL AS CountryId
	,BCD.TMDATE AS PeriodStartDate
	,convert(date,NULL) AS PeriodEndDate
	,BCA.STRUSERFIELD17 AS NationalId
	,NULL AS PassportId
	,NULL AS CitizenshipTypeId
	,BCD.NATIONALITY AS NationalityId
	,BCD.Source_Code AS SourceSystemCode
	,BCD.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,BCD.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC_DELTA BCDD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC BCD ON BCDD.DEMOGRAPHICID = BCD.DEMOGRAPHICID AND BCDD.BANK_ID = BCD.BANK_ID AND BCD.isLatest = '1'
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS BCA  ON BCD.ORGKEY = BCA.ORGKEY  AND BCA.isLatest = 1
where BCD.ORGKEY is not null

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship;


-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_SRC AS (
    SELECT 
        HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
		CustomerId
		,CountryId
		,PeriodStartDate
		,PeriodEndDate
		,NationalId
		,PassportId
		,CitizenshipTypeId
		,NationalityId
		,SourceSystemCode
		,FinancialInstitutionId
		)) HASHROW, CustomerId, RECORD_STATUS 
    FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship
    WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_TGT AS (
    SELECT  
        HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
		CustomerId
		,CountryId
		,PeriodStartDate
		,PeriodEndDate
		,NationalId
		,PassportId
		,CitizenshipTypeId
		,NationalityId
		,SourceSystemCode
		,FinancialInstitutionId
		)) HASHROW, CustomerId
	FROM BNKM.CustomerCountryOfCitizenship
	WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CRM' AND PeriodEndDate IS NULL
)


,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA AS (
	SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerID,TGT.CustomerID) AS CustomerID
		--,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,CASE
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID
--AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA;


---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
[PeriodEndDate] = SRC.PeriodStartDate
FROM BNKM.CustomerCountryOfCitizenship TGT 
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship SRC ON SRC.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID 
WHERE  TGT.PeriodEndDate IS NULL;

-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerCountryOfCitizenship (
[CustomerId]
,[CountryId]
,[PeriodStartDate]
,[PeriodEndDate]
,[NationalId]
,[PassportId]
,[CitizenshipTypeId]
,[NationalityId]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm])

SELECT     
	SRC.CustomerId
	,SRC.CountryId
	,SRC.PeriodStartDate
	,SRC.PeriodEndDate
	,SRC.NationalId
	,SRC.PassportId
	,SRC.CitizenshipTypeId
	,SRC.NationalityId
	,'CRM' AS SourceSystemCode
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,SRC.InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerID = SRC.CustomerID  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'



-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerCountryOfCitizenship (
[CustomerId]
,[CountryId]
,[PeriodStartDate]
,[PeriodEndDate]
,[NationalId]
,[PassportId]
,[CitizenshipTypeId]
,[NationalityId]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm])

SELECT     
	CustomerId
	,CountryId
	,PeriodStartDate
	,PeriodEndDate
	,NationalId
	,PassportId
	,CitizenshipTypeId
	,NationalityId
	,'CRM' AS SourceSystemCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerCountryOfCitizenship_DELTA;

END
GO
